current_episode.title: Episode 31: 2026 Mid-Year State of the Freight

guest.bio_context: Brett Leifert is Director of Innovation and Strategy at Fetch Freight, where he analyzes supply chain market trends, capacity dynamics, regulatory impacts, and freight demand patterns. He provides regular market forecasts and webinar analyses on trucking industry conditions.

context.real_quote: This is truly a supply driven recovery. Demands have some green shoots, but it's really more about the exit of capacity.
key_stats: Spot rates 30% to 40% higher inclusive of fuel compared to prior year
Spot rates 20% to 30% higher excluding fuel compared to prior year
Contract rate increases averaging 7.5% this cycle, ranging 5% to 10%
Inventory-to-sales ratios at lowest point since early COVID around 2021
Tens of thousands of non-domicile CDL drivers left the market after FMCSA enforcement
Roughly 2,000 Mexican drivers lost visa to enter U.S. due to cabotage enforcement
North of 50 CDL schools closed in southwest, Texas, and California
Over 100 different ELD device manufacturers operate in the market
DOT Blitz Week rates doubled and tripled on some lanes
